our_interpretation: Cash burn means cumulative negative free cash flow, consistent with the surrounding annual free-cash-flow discussion. It excludes fundraising, non-cash losses, and unspent contractual commitments.
The comparison period is calendar 2025 through 2029 because the surrounding projection table begins in 2025.
The latest reasonable deadline is December 31, 2029. The phrase could instead mean the beginning of 2029; that ambiguity does not affect the present assessment.
Survival means continuing to operate as OpenAI through the chosen endpoint.
The separate expression of disbelief in OpenAI's survival is not scored as an additional claim.
The accounting basis is estimate because Zitron builds his forecast from reported financial projections.
criteria.support_condition: OpenAI survives through the endpoint and comparable realized cash-flow records show cumulative net cash burn exceeding USD 290 billion during calendar 2025–2029.
criteria.contradiction_condition: OpenAI survives through the endpoint and comparable complete cash-flow records show cumulative net cash burn of USD 290 billion or less during calendar 2025–2029.
